style: Original surreal graphic sculpture; cobalt, acid, coral, chalk, lavender and ink
authoring: Blender Python / Crearo, original geometry and deterministic hand-authored pigment textures
license: Original project assets; no third-party model or texture downloads
units: meters; runtime X-right, Y-up, Z-front (Blender authoring Z-up is converted on export)

Loop.usdz.origin: feet at Y=0; +Z is the front of the eye
